title: Milt Hinton as a boy on Rose Avenue

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What kind of kid was Milt?
Oh, he was an average kid, as I can remember. All went to school together, and played ball together a little bit. We didn't play too much with each other, at least I didn't play too much ball.
Well, you got started a little bit ahead of them, didn't you, in playing?

I guess I did, because I don't remember what become of Milt. All I remember, when I started taking violin lessons, I remember Milt's people started giving him violin lessons. Then when he moved away, I don't know what happened.
But I got started playing with these different bands while I was still living on Rose Avenue. I played (inaudible).
